svg.text: Recursive Flint 40B-A2.5B, 4-bit, on an M5 Pro 48 GB: speed by prompt length
MacBook Pro M5 Pro (20-core GPU), 48 GB · macOS 26.5.2 · AC power, High Power mode · Flint 4-bit (Kapitsa: Recursive's MLX 4-bit; llama.cpp: Recursive's Q4_1 GGUF) · T 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20
point: median of the runs · bar: min-max
Prefill: prompt tokens ÷ time to first token (tok/s)
Decode: a 512-token answer after the prompt (tok/s)

Each request cold (a random nonce opens the prompt; no prompt cache), one engine at a time, one request at a time, plain decoding (no speculative decoding). bench/results/2026-10-24-flint-m5pro-context
